Package org.apache.hadoop.mapreduce.lib.db

Class DBConfiguration

java.lang.Object
org.apache.hadoop.mapreduce.lib.db.DBConfiguration
Direct Known Subclasses:
DBConfiguration
@Public @Stable public class DBConfiguration extends Object
A container for configuration property names for jobs with DB input/output. The job can be configured using the static methods in this class, DBInputFormat, and DBOutputFormat. Alternatively, the properties can be set in the configuration with proper values.
See Also:
  • configureDB(Configuration, String, String, String, String)
  • DBInputFormat.setInput(Job, Class, String, String)
  • DBInputFormat.setInput(Job, Class, String, String, String, String...)
  • DBOutputFormat.setOutput(Job, String, String...)
